sigma_rules.title: Loading of Kernel Module via Insmod
sigma_rules.author: Pawel Mazur

strategies.name: Detection Strategy for Kernel Modules and Extensions Autostart Execution

analytics.name: Analytic 1243
analytics.guidance: Monitor kernel module load/unload activity via modprobe, insmod, rmmod, or direct manipulation of /lib/modules. Correlate with installation of kernel headers, compilation commands, or downloads of .ko files. Detect anomalies in unsigned module loading or repeated module load attempts under non-root users.

tuning.description: Scope detection to non-root or unexpected users performing module-related activity
Limit alerts to module activity outside approved change windows
Adjust regex pattern for directories to monitor depending on kernel version or distro

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: Execution of insmod, modprobe, or rmmod commands by non-standard users or outside expected timeframes

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: Access or modification to /lib/modules or creation of .ko files

log_sources.name: linux:osquery
log_sources.channel: New or modified kernel object files (.ko) within /lib/modules directory

analytics.name: Analytic 1244
analytics.guidance: Detect user-initiated kextload commands or modifications to /Library/Extensions. Correlate with changes to KextPolicy database or unauthorized developer signing identities. Alert on attempts to disable SIP or load legacy extensions from unsigned sources.

tuning.description: Approved developer IDs whose kexts should not trigger alerts
Threshold for detecting kext loads outside standard install/update operations
Flag to enforce strict signing checks depending on SIP status

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: kextload execution from Terminal or suspicious paths

log_sources.name: macos:osquery
log_sources.channel: Processes executing kextload, spctl, or modifying kernel extension directories

log_sources.name: macos:osquery
log_sources.channel: New kext entries not signed by Apple or outside standard identifier prefix
